app_info.subtitle: Create images and videos
app_info.description: Magic Hour lets ChatGPT create and edit images, video, and audio through authenticated Magic Hour tools. Generate images, edit supplied photos, animate images, swap faces, and retrieve completed media. Generation uses the applicable Magic Hour credits.

test_cases.user_prompt: Create a cinematic product photo of a perfume bottle on black marble with warm studio lighting.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates exactly one image project, waits for terminal success, and returns the completed image using its exact download URL without repeating generation.

test_cases.description: Edit an attached image containing a background person; provide a reviewer fixture before running.
test_cases.user_prompt: Remove the person in the background from this image and keep everything else the same.
test_cases.expected_output: Transfers the attached image into accessible storage before generation, uses Image Editor once, waits for terminal success, and returns the edited image with the background person removed and other content preserved.

test_cases.description: Animate an attached product photo; provide a reviewer fixture before running.
test_cases.user_prompt: Turn this product photo into a subtle five-second cinematic product video. Keep the product identity unchanged.
test_cases.expected_output: Transfers or references the supplied image, creates exactly one five-second Image-to-Video project, waits for terminal success, and returns the finished video with the product identity preserved.

test_cases.description: Swap faces between two attached consenting-adult or synthetic photos; provide reviewer fixtures before running.
test_cases.user_prompt: Put the face from the first photo onto the person in the second photo. Keep the second photo’s background and clothing unchanged.
test_cases.expected_output: Correctly assigns source and target images, uploads both before generation, creates one Face Swap Photo project, waits for terminal success, and returns the completed swap.

test_cases.description: Create one source image and animate it into one video.
test_cases.user_prompt: Create a cinematic perfume product photo on black marble, then animate it into a subtle five-second video.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates one source image, waits for it, uses that completed image as the Image-to-Video input, creates one five-second video, waits for success, and returns the final video without duplicate jobs.

negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Write three hooks for my video ad. Don't create any media.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Answers with text or asks for writing context; does not invoke any Magic Hour tool or spend generation credits.

negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Move tomorrow's team meeting to Friday.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Does not invoke Magic Hour; routes to an appropriate calendar capability or explains that calendar access is unavailable.

negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What makes a good product video?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Answers with guidance without invoking Magic Hour or starting paid generation.
